# Psalm 132 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** A-song of-the-ascents. Remember O-YHWH for-David all his-affliction,

**2** Who swore to-YHWH, vowed to-Mighty-One-of Jacob:

**3** 'If I-enter the-tent-of my-house, if I-go-up on the-couch-of my-bed,

**4** If I-give sleep to-my-eyes, to-my-eyelids slumber,

**5** Until I-find a-place for-YHWH, dwellings for-Mighty-One-of Jacob.'

**6** Behold we-heard-of-it in-Ephrathah; we-found-it in-fields-of Jaar.

**7** Let-us-go to-his-dwellings; let-us-bow-down at-footstool-of his-feet.

**8** Arise O-YHWH to-your-resting-place, you and-the-ark-of your-strength.

**9** Your-priests let-them-be-clothed-in righteousness, and-your-faithful-ones let-them-shout-for-joy.

**10** For-sake-of David your-servant, do-not turn-away the-face-of your-anointed.

**11** Has-sworn YHWH to-David truth, not he-will-turn from-it: 'From-fruit-of your-body I-will-set on-your-throne.

**12** If keep your-sons my-covenant and-my-testimony that I-will-teach-them, also their-sons forever will-sit on-your-throne.'

**13** For has-chosen YHWH Zion; he-has-desired-it for-his-dwelling:

**14** 'This my-resting-place forever; here I-will-dwell for I-have-desired-it.

**15** Her-provision blessing I-will-bless; her-poor I-will-satisfy with-bread.

**16** And-her-priests I-will-clothe-with salvation, and-her-faithful-ones shouting will-shout-for-joy.

**17** There I-will-make-sprout a-horn for-David; I-have-prepared a-lamp for-my-anointed.

**18** His-enemies I-will-clothe-with shame, and-upon-him will-flourish his-crown.'

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **132:17**: 'I-will-make-sprout a-horn for-David' — tsemach (sprout/branch) — messianic vocabulary; the horn and lamp symbolize the continuation of Davidic rule.

— EMET
